svg.title: C06-M04-F3: Broken function-level control in the lab
svg.desc: A comparison of the vulnerable admin check that trusts a client-supplied role cookie against the hardened check that requires an authenticated admin session.
svg.text: C06-M04-F3 Broken function-level control in the lab
GET /admin with Cookie: role=admin (no real admin session)
vuln: if cookie role == admin -> show all users (trusts client)
fixed: if session.role == admin -> show; else 403 (trusts server)
rule: decide from the authenticated session, deny by default
Figure C06-M04-F3. The vulnerable /admin trusts a client cookie; the fix
